$comment: Leaderboard configuration (SPEC §2/§3). Reference targets are published claims, never ranked. prize_excluded_operators lists GitHub handles whose rows render but never qualify for any prize (AntFleet reference submissions).

patch_reference_targets.label: GPT-5.3-Codex — Patch SOTA
patch_reference_targets.note: This is a detect+patch task (upstream PATCH.md): the agent audits the contracts and fixes the bugs it finds — no findings are provided. It is ONLY comparable to blind-audit Open EVMBench Patch submissions, not finding-fed ones.

patch_task_modes.$comment: Patch submissions MUST declare task_mode. Only blind-audit ranks against the 41.5% SOTA.
patch_task_modes.blind-audit: Agent gets the repo + README scope only and must DETECT and fix the vulnerabilities (upstream PATCH.md). Comparable to the 41.5% SOTA. Reference scaffold: agents/cursor_fleet/patch_auditor_blind.py.
patch_task_modes.finding-fed: Agent is given each finding (root cause + recommended fix) and the exact target file, and implements the described fix. NOT comparable to the 41.5% SOTA — it scores far higher because detection is removed. Scaffold: agents/cursor_fleet/patch_auditor.py.

patch_comparability_disclosures.detail: The promoted antfleet-ops GPT-5.5 reference (43/44) was produced finding-fed: the scaffold injected each audit finding (root cause + recommended fix) and the target file, so it measures 'implement a described fix', not the detect+patch task the 41.5% SOTA measures. It must NOT be ranked against 41.5%. A blind-audit re-run (patch_auditor_blind.py) is the paper-comparable number. See docs/PHASE2_GAMEABILITY.md § Task-mode comparability.

patch_gameability_disclosures.detail: Upstream's invariant guard for this audit tolerates 59 test failures and is non-discriminating: the gold patch and a degenerate 'brick' patch produce the identical invariant failure set, so a brick that never fixes the bug scores 2/2. These 2 of 44 Patch tasks are NOT degenerate-proof. Scored as-is to preserve upstream's 44-task denominator (comparable to the 41.5% SOTA); disclosed here per the gameability probe.
